note: Routt NF (Yampa RD) campground 11 mi SW of Yampa via CR 7 (paved for 7 mi), then dirt FR 900 past Yamcolo Reservoir, ~9,700 ft, in mixed conifer and aspen. Cash or check only. Last several miles are rough washboard dirt but passable by a normal vehicle. Bear Lake (30 ac) is a short walk outside the entrance; no campsites are on the shoreline. --Claude
summary: FS page: confirmed 43 sites (3 double, 1 triple), trailers to 30 ft, vault toilets, potable water, $20 single ($30/$40 double/triple); season mid-June to early/mid Oct (no exact dates, recorded as a note); not on recreation.gov so FCFS only. All groups now manual. Note trimmed of field restatements.
flags: Missing phone: Yampa Ranger District (970) 638-4516 (https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/mbrtb/offices). The campground page gives no other contact.

Pin may be on the day-use loop, not the campground: the stored pin 40.0453,-107.0725 sits on the open loop with a parking area at Bear Lake's NE corner by the dam, which matches the FS description of the free fishing pier and picnic area 'a short walk outside of the campground's entrance'. The FS page's own lat/lng, 40.04598,-107.07005 (~230 m ENE), falls among a set of spur roads in dense conifer east of the dam that look like the camping loops. Not on recreation.gov, so no per-site points to settle it; Overpass was unreachable.

Lakeview (stored) is a re-audit lead, waterfront not changed: on imagery the forested spur loops around the FS lat/lng lie ~200-600 m east of Bear Lake, below and behind the dam in dense conifer, with no open sightline to the water evident. The 2026-10-21 dam screen treated the NE-corner loop as the campground; if that loop is the day-use area (previous flag), the lakeview basis goes with it.

Status: the FS page shows a 'Site Closed' badge today (2026-10-28), consistent with the stated mid-June to early/mid-October season; the Yampa RD entry in the forest conditions table (as of 10/6/2026) says 'Campgrounds are beginning to close for the season.' Ordinary seasonal closing, not recorded as a status. The Stillwater Reservoir dam-work alert on FR 900 (trailhead only, 'No closures are in place') ended 2026-10-16.
